answer: A verifiable-delay-function entry ticket. (1) Each identity must grind a strictly sequential puzzle — 6 hours on one core, no shortcuts — before it can act. (2) It posts the proof; nodes verify it in milliseconds. (3) Ticketless identities are ignored. (4) Every epoch demands a fresh proof. Renting cores never shortens sequential depth: 10,000 sybils burn 60,000 core-hours, ~$3,000 of spot compute, and the bill recurs every epoch. Sybil farming becomes hauling sleds across a tundra: more sleds, same slow caravan; the mesa never nears faster, and the karst swallows parallel tracks.
